Task list with priorities, status and stack usage.
queries.review: No argument enumerates OS tasks. A02F621C builds/sorts a bounded 149-entry scratch task-pointer table at 20BDD678; A02F6274 scans stack sentinel words. A02F629A updates display totals at 20BDD8D0/4. No task-priority/state setter calls. Display counters/scratch are written, live task configuration is not.

queries.purpose: Probe advertised task-latency command; expected return 0 only.
queries.review: Exact handler is MOVS r0,#0; BX LR. No arguments used and no measurements emitted.

queries.purpose: Show image-pipeline history; retail per-record formatting is compiled out.
queries.review: No args supplies zero to A01C95FC, which defaults to 200 records. Reads 209E3038 history index, does modulo arithmetic and calls A01C964C (BX LR) for each slot; no target mutation. Optional numeric count uses strtol but large counts are unnecessary; use no args only.

queries.purpose: Probe current buffer debug view; expected return 0 only.
queries.review: Reads buffer pointer at 209E28DC+54 and, when nonzero, calls A01C6E7E. That helper only performs bounded pointer/count loops; no print call or target dereference/store remains in this retail image.

queries.readiness: reviewed; lazy registration may be absent
queries.purpose: Probe advertised circular-buffer diagnostic if dynamically registered.
queries.review: No args passes zero to A01C6E7E. The helper walks addresses in [209E2A50,209E2F90) with stride A8 and has no print call or target memory read/store. Optional numeric address is unnecessary; use no args.

queries.purpose: Print image-pipeline LMB state and counters.
queries.review: 119 reachable ARM instructions reviewed; accesses RAM state rooted at 209E50D8 and formats fields through A03CEA16. Only stores are to stack; all calls are UART formatting (including ARM interworking veneer A03CEA0C). No MMIO or configuration mutation in reviewed handler.

discovery.analysis: Traverses shell linked list and formats FUNC/VAR, name, target and optional description. Prefix matching only. Writes its stack/print buffers, not registry objects.
discovery.gate: Both registered at A03D0060/A03D006A only if A03D03E8 -> A00089DF returns zero. No supported read-only command identified that enables omitted registrations. Do not patch RAM or call handlers through func_call.
discovery.head_provenance: A03D002A initializer and A03D0092 registrar use 20DA30E8; A03D0092 prepends each allocated 20-byte record.
discovery.memory_read_signature: udw.mem_read <width_selector> <decimal_address>; width 0 byte, 1 halfword, 2 word. Handler A02613A5 parses %d %d. Exact command above is one aligned DDR word read.
read_walk_constraints: Read-only DDR list traversal with cycle and node-count bounds; stop on null, invalid alignment/range or malformed node.
Resolve name/description pointers against verified offline image when their read-only image address and firmware identity match, rather than reading unrelated live ranges.
Do not transplant 2017 head 20DA71AC or old emulator object handles.
No runtime memory writes are needed.
discovery.safe_ddr_node_pool: Initializer reserves 4000 bytes starting 0x20DA30F8, end-exclusive 0x20DA4098; 20-byte nodes allocated by A03D0070.

variable_read_semantics.signature: <exact variable name> with no arguments and no equals sign
variable_read_semantics.provenance: A03CFC90 looks up the name; A03CFCB2 selects kind=0; A03CFCBE requires argc=1; A03CFCC2/A03CFCC4 dereference the registered target word and print it. The target-store instruction A03CFB62 belongs to the separate assignment path.
variable_read_semantics.side_effects: Shell parsing/printing buffers only; variable target itself is read.

conditional_queries.command_template: i <exact task name copied from the preceding live i output>
conditional_queries.precondition: The name is present in current live task list.
conditional_queries.review: A02F6382 looks up by exact task name (strcmp at A02F63AE); no match returns -1. It does not accept a raw TCB address as a substitute for the name.

conditional_queries.precondition: Read word at 0x20DA30F4 (udws "udw.mem_read 2 551170292;"). It must be a valid aligned DDR pointer. Read its first word; expected vtable 0xA05C9B90. Only then use that live pointer.
conditional_queries.review: A03D004A creates this mutex via A02F5ED0 and stores its handle at head+0xC. A02F5ED0 sets vtable A05C9B90. semShow requires argc=2; A03CEB8E parses hexadecimal with optional 0x; A02F5FFE calls object vtable+0xC to obtain status. The virtual call occurs before vtable classification, so guessed handles are unsafe. A valid shell mutex remains allocated for shell life.

conditional_queries.precondition: No verified event handle supplied by this static review. Exclude from automatic batch until a live handle and type are verified.
conditional_queries.review: Requires argc=2 and nonzero hex handle, then A02F61E6 ultimately enters semaphore-status logic. Event vtable is A05C9B70; do not reuse old emulator addresses.

hardware_diagnostics.automatic_batch: separate explicitly flagged hardware diagnostic, not pure RAM query
hardware_diagnostics.review: Reads 16-bit MMIO BD071C18/1A, BD066404/408/402, BD073416/12/14, formats status/counters. A00292A8 briefly masks/restores interrupts around snapshot. No MMIO write or motor start call in this handler; peripheral read effects are hardware-specific.

hardware_diagnostics.automatic_batch: requires initialized pipeline context; defer pending current state validation
hardware_diagnostics.review: Reads RAM rooted at 209E3F70 and 209E4074 and cached fields; also reads MMIO BD071C18/1A, BD072002/4, BD073000/2. Dereferences context at 209E3FD4 before checking null. A01CE980 is a RAM getter for 209E410C. No writes except stack in reviewed handler, but missing pipeline context can fault.
